hypothesis: The source-resolved greedy programs should stop by a scientific marginal-improvement rule rather than an arbitrary depth ceiling. The has/had path already crossed that rule after eight components; is/was still had active improvement at ten and should extend until convergence.
frozen_rule: Accept a component only when the best A1-fit unit-target MSE improvement is strictly greater than 0.001; stop at the first step that fails this bar or when the 20-component pool is exhausted.

starting_evidence.has_had: v2 step 8 MSE 0.0686348594; step 9 best improvement 0.0004838858, so the converged prefix is frozen at eight without rerunning selection
starting_evidence.is_was: v2 step 10 MSE 0.0980375288 with improvement 0.0040163146, so selection resumes prospectively from its ten-component prefix

predictions.pred_a_authority_prefix_reproduction_cap: The is/was ten-component fit MSE reproduces within 1e-5; all evaluation panels remain capable; at most 70 forwards, 665 evaluations, and 515 records.
predictions.pred_b_is_was_reaches_marginal_convergen: is/was selects at least one new component, stops before all 20 components, and the first rejected best improvement is at most 0.001.
predictions.pred_c_converged_paths_preserve_out_of_s: has/had remains within 0.005 of v2 recovery on heldout/A2; is/was is no worse than v2 on either panel; all directions remain donorward.
predictions.pred_d_programs_remain_sparse_and_shared: Both paths contain fewer than 20 components and share at least eight labels.
predictions.pred_e_zero_fit_parameters: No fitted scalar, backward pass, or model update.

decision: screen seals the converged programs for selective-removal testing; null if marginal convergence harms quality or sharing; invalid on authority, reproduction, capability, coverage, finiteness, stopping-rule, or price failure
